narr: A big push of monsoon moisture led to ten days of scattered thunderstorms over the Mojave Desert and southern Great Basin. Many storms produced flash flooding and/or high winds. Events in this episode are continued in the July 22-26 Thunderstorms episode.
ev: Flash flooding in Cold Creek washed out the shoulders of some roads.
One foot of water flowed over the intersection of Boulder Highway and Sunset.
Hidden Valley Road was closed at the Muddy River crossing due to flooding.
Water flowed over Interstate 15 near Moapa, causing traffic to be diverted.
The Overton Wash flooded Highway 169 about two feet deep.
